# A Fixture Paper on Citations

## Introduction

Paradigms shift when anomalies accumulate (Kuhn). Lending follows growth (Lindqvist and Berg). The same shift recurs (Kuhn).

Several studies agree (Lindqvist and Berg; Okafor). Trust can be measured (Okafor 40). Networks persist (Okafor 41).

## Discussion

Lindqvist and Berg argue that lending policy follows growth.
